manual_cancel.reason: The test polling loop cannot recognize the accepted ReadyForResolution pair terminal and would wait until the configured 9000-second limit despite complete durable success.

root_cause: Pass1ProductionExecutionTests.WaitForTerminalAsync recognizes Completed and CompletedWithWarnings, which are Scan Execution/coordination concepts and are not values of Pass1PairExecutionPhase. The production API correctly returns the pair's accepted Story 12.3 terminal ReadyForResolution, so the T062 harness continues polling indefinitely and its subsequent success assertion is unreachable.
